name: The Status Serpent
smell: The hotspot of Taskly: the function changed in 4 of 7 commits, with branches nested inside branches.
intro: Its body is computeTaskStatus from src/services/taskService.ts. Each row is a line of code; each step to the right is one level of nesting.

inputs.telegraph: a task with no due date
a task that is done, finished before its due date
a task that is done, finished after its due date
an open task with dueDate 1, using a fixed now of 100

questions.explanation: `!task.dueDate` is true when dueDate is missing (or 0). The other two tasks have a due date.
Only the second task has `done: true`.

questions.prompt: For which task is `task.doneAt > task.dueDate` true?
questions.explanation: 20 > 10 is true. 10 > 10 is false (finishing exactly on the due date is not late), and 5 > 10 is false.

questions.prompt: With now fixed at 100, which task reaches line 14 and makes `now > task.dueDate` true?
questions.evidence: tests/taskService.test.ts:18 expects "overdue" for { dueDate: 1, done: false }
questions.explanation: With now fixed at 100, 100 > 1 is true and 100 > 8640000000000000 is false. `{ done: false }` returns on line 7 before reaching line 14.
Date.now() returns the milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC as a number, which is why line 14 can compare it with dueDate.
No due date, so line 7 returns "open" right away.

questions.prompt: What does `computeTaskStatus({ dueDate: 10, done: true, doneAt: 20 })` return?
questions.explanation: It's done (line 8), and finished at 20, after the due date 10 (line 9), so line 10 returns "late".

questions.prompt: What does `computeTaskStatus({ dueDate: 10, done: true, doneAt: 5 })` return?
questions.explanation: It's done (line 8) and finished at 5, before the due date 10, so line 9 is false and line 11 returns "done".

questions.prompt: With now fixed at 100, what does `computeTaskStatus({ dueDate: 1, done: false })` return?
questions.explanation: It has a due date and isn't done, so it reaches line 14. 100 > 1 is true, so it returns "overdue".

questions.prompt: With now fixed at 100, which task leaves through `return "open"` on line 15?
questions.explanation: `{ done: false }` returns on line 7. DueDate 1 is below now 100, so is overdue. DueDate 8640000000000000 is above the fixed now, so falls through to line 15.

questions.prompt: Trace `computeTaskStatus({ done: false })`: which lines run?
questions.evidence: tests/taskService.test.ts:6 ("open"), and only line 7 returns "open" before line 15
questions.explanation: Line 7 is true (no due date) and returns at once.

questions.prompt: Trace `computeTaskStatus({ dueDate: 10, done: true, doneAt: 5 })`: which lines run?
questions.evidence: tests/taskService.test.ts:10 ("done" is returned only on line 11)
questions.explanation: 7 is false, 8 is true, 9 is false (5 > 10 is false), so line 11 returns "done".

questions.prompt: Trace `computeTaskStatus({ dueDate: 10, done: true, doneAt: 20 })`: which lines run?
questions.evidence: tests/taskService.test.ts:14 ("late" is returned only on line 10)
questions.explanation: 7 is false, 8 is true, 9 is true (20 > 10), so line 10 returns "late".

questions.prompt: With now fixed at 100, trace `computeTaskStatus({ dueDate: 1, done: false })`: which lines run?
questions.evidence: tests/taskService.test.ts:18 ("overdue" is returned only on line 14)
questions.explanation: 7 and 8 are false, line 13 reads the clock, and line 14 is true, so it returns "overdue" there.

hints.c1: A joint guards the cells nested under it (to its right). This one asks whether the task has a due date at all.
hints.c2: This heart is the earliest way out of the function. Which tasks leave this soon?
hints.c3: Everything indented under this joint (three cells) only runs for one kind of task. Severing it removes all of them.
hints.c4: A comparison between two timestamps. Watch out for equal values.
hints.c5: The deepest heart. To get here, two joints above it must both say yes.
hints.c6: A heart one level in: inside the first joint, but past the second one.
hints.c7: An organ is a call to another function. This one reads the current time.
hints.c8: Only open tasks with a due date ever reach this joint.
hints.c9: Leaves when the clock has passed the due date.
hints.c10: The last way out. Notice it returns the same word as the very first heart, for a very different reason.

phases.name: Phase 2: the Serpent sheds its skin
phases.telegraph: The Serpent sheds its skin! Cells you read are hidden again, and its strikes hurt more.

smellAttack.name: Tangle
smellAttack.text: The Serpent wraps you in tangled branches.
